name: opencode-model-discovery
description: OpenCode plugin that discovers models from OpenAI-compatible providers

scripts.build: rimraf dist && tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/opencode-model-discovery.js && tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run test:run && npm run build
